title: anaphalioides keriensis
intro: Anaphalioides keriensis, commonly known as New Zealand rock daisy, is a plant species belonging to the family Compositae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Anaphalioides keriensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its potential as a natural remedy for various health issues.
